mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current FEDFUNDS value of 1.21% meets this condition, so the mechanism predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 0.2% in the past month, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns. The current FEDFUNDS change meets this condition, so the mechanism predicts negative returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls by more than 0.5% in the past month and employment (PAYEMS) falls by more than 0.3% in the past month, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns. The current INDPRO and PAYEMS values meet this joint condition, so the mechanism predicts negative returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month AND PAYEMS falls > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month AND PAYEMS falls > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns. The current CPIAUCSL value of 295.328 is below 300, so the signal is inactive. However, the mechanism is defined for when the condition is met.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% in the past month, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns. The current CPIAUCSL change meets this condition, so the mechanism predicts negative returns.
